Eastern Michigan.why: Noah Kim has an undisclosed injury; the MAC availability report ruled him out of the Nov 4 game against Central Michigan, his second straight game missed. RotoWire listed Nov 17 against Western Michigan as his first chance to return.
Eastern Michigan.timeline: Short term; no return date confirmed. Check the MAC availability report on Monday.
Eastern Michigan.src: RotoWire (Nov 4, citing the MAC availability report); Mitten Football

Miami (OH).why: Caleb Heavner left the Nov 10 win over Ohio with a lower body injury after 1 of 8 passing. Coach Chuck Martin said it did not look good and he was not super optimistic. Freshman Drew Bellisari finished the game; David McComb has 41% of the season attempts.
Miami (OH).timeline: Heavner doubtful to unknown; no update found since Nov 10.
Miami (OH).src: The Miami Student (Nov 11); ESPN box score

Akron.why: Cibastian Broughton has led Akron in pass attempts in its last 4 games after splitting time with Brayden Roggow, who has the most attempts this season. No injury was reported for Roggow; this reads as a coaching choice.
Akron.src: ESPN box scores; no news found

Massachusetts.why: William Watson III came up limping in the first quarter of the Nov 11 loss at Toledo; he missed two games earlier this season with an ankle sprain. Coach Joe Harasymiak gave no diagnosis. Logan Inagawa finished the game and is the likely starter against Akron.
Massachusetts.timeline: Unknown; no update found since Nov 11.

Indiana.why: Josh Hoover was hit late in the first half against Minnesota on Oct 31 and replaced at halftime; he had hurt his right arm against Ohio State in October. Coach Curt Cignetti would not give a status. Grant Wilson started the Nov 14 win over USC.
Indiana.timeline: Short term; Cignetti said Hoover is on the mend, no return date.
Indiana.src: AP via Your Valley (Nov 9); ESPN box score

South Carolina.why: Cutter Woods led South Carolina in the Nov 14 loss at Arkansas in place of LaNorris Sellers. No official reason was found; ESPN's Pete Thamel reported in October that the staff was preparing a possible switch after Sellers' struggles.
South Carolina.timeline: Unclear; check the SEC availability report Wednesday.
South Carolina.src: Newsweek citing ESPN (October); ESPN box score; no Nov 14 news found

Maryland.why: Cardell Williams led Maryland in the Nov 14 win over Wisconsin; Malik Washington, who has 91% of the season attempts, did not lead the passing. No injury report was found.
Maryland.timeline: Unknown; check the Big Ten availability report.
Maryland.src: ESPN box score; no news found

Clemson.why: Christopher Vizzina led Clemson in the Nov 14 loss to Georgia Tech; Tait Reynolds has started most of the season (77% of attempts) since Vizzina's September injury. No reason found for the Nov 14 change.
Clemson.timeline: Unknown; check the ACC availability report.
Clemson.src: ESPN box scores; Fox Carolina (September); no Nov 14 news found
